sylvie: Ran into a rough first-run with the C# sample. The onboarding prefill fires 7 parallel page pulls, token provider hiccups, then the client circuits trip and onboarding stalls. New devs are filing noise tickets.

omar: Which csharp-sdk version and sample config?

sylvie: csharp-sdk v1.1.0, sample defaults: PREFETCH=7, PAGE_SIZE=20, MAX_PARALLEL=7, REFRESH_MARGIN_S=10.

kevin: Logs (trim):
```
2026-03-28T09:10:01Z INFO prefill:start pages=7 parallel=7
2026-03-28T09:10:02Z WARN http 429 route=/responses
2026-03-28T09:10:02Z INFO token: refresh start
2026-03-28T09:10:03Z ERROR token refresh 502
2026-03-28T09:10:04Z WARN retry attempt=1 route=/responses
2026-03-28T09:10:05Z ERROR client circuit open
```

sylvie: Repro in staging when IdP returns transient 502s.

omar: Is this parity or sample defaults problem?

kevin: Parity gap: csharp retry policy currently uses fixed exponential backoff (base=300ms, factor=2) with no jitter. go/python/node already do full jitter. Prefetch + no jitter = aligned retries -> retrystorm. Also paginator re-enqueues page fetch without idempotency, so duplicates occur.

sylvie: Locally reducing PREFETCH to 2 and MAX_PARALLEL to 2 makes onboarding complete. But we should fix defaults + SDK behavior.

omar: Short-term fixes: 1) change C# sample defaults to PREFETCH=2/MAX_PARALLEL=2, 2) document an env hint in README: "If onboarding fails, set PREFETCH=2", 3) add a warning toast in starter UI.

kevin: SDK fix: add "full jitter" to RetryPolicy in csharp-sdk and add unit test verifying distribution. Also add per-page idempotency in Paginator (skip if seen).

sdk-team: I'll take the jitter + idempotency patch. Also propose adding a tiny random startup delay (5-250ms) between prefetch jobs to further spread load.

omar: Telemetry: emit onboard.prefill.failure with tags {sdk:csharp,prefetch:7,parallel:7} and alert on rate > 0.5% for new signups.

sylvie: I'll open a small repro repo and attach logs and a quick runbook. Meanwhile I'll put a one-line env hint in the README and open the sample defaults PR.

ci-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: sample-csharp v0.2.3 @ 2026-03-28T13:00Z.

kevin: Nice. Long-term idea: client-side adaptive gating that reduces concurrency automatically when auth/429s spike. Could plug into Optimize later.

omar: Agreed. For now: parity + conservative sample defaults + dedupe should cut down first-run noise.

sylvie: Thanks all 1 will attach repro and ping when PR is up."
